title: 3.3 Linear Functions

icans: I can tell from a graph or a table whether a function is linear.
I can tell from an equation whether a function is linear.
I can decide whether a domain is discrete or continuous.

vocab: a function whose graph is a ______________ line; it has a constant rate of change
a function without a ___________ rate of change
___________ input values (counts, such as people or tickets)
all values in an ___________ (measurements, such as time or weight)

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Linear functions: A function is linear when its rate of change is _______________.

blocks.stem:
Is each equation linear?
a.  y = 3x − 7        b.  y = x² + 1        c.  y = 5/x        d.  2x + 3y = 6
The graph shows two functions. Which one is linear?

notes: Discrete and continuous: Discrete domain: you can only _______________. Continuous domain: you can _______________.

blocks.stem:
Is the domain discrete or continuous?
a.  the number of tickets sold and the money collected
b.  the gallons of gas pumped and the cost
